predictions.text: I predict that the airport suspensions at a major international airport will be extended.

grade.line: By 16 October an airline had extended its suspension of Riyadh flights from 16 October to 18 November. The prediction named no airport or airline, so any extension would have fit.

predictions.text: I predict that the second round run-off elections for Senate seats will result in a victory for the candidates from the Czech Social Democratic Party in at least two districts.

grade.line: The run-off began on 16 October and its results came the next day, after the due date. Opposition parties won 22 of the 27 contested seats.

predictions.text: I predict that the co-production agreement between ABS-CBN and TV5 will be finalized as planned.

grade.line: The co-production deal was signed on 11 October, the day before this was foretold, and the show returned to TV5 on 18 October.

predictions.text: I predict that attacks on prominent airports in major cities will continue, with at least one more attack involving the firing of a missile, resulting in additional injuries.

grade.line: The Houthis claimed another missile strike on Riyadh's airport on 12 October, with no injuries reported. Missile debris hurt four people in Riyadh on 14 October; no airport was named.

predictions.text: I predict that 365,000 people in Alabama and Florida will have power restored by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026.

grade.line: Reports gave the number of customers who lost power but no figures for how many had it back by 19 October.

predictions.text: I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see another targeted vessel, likely involving Iran and the United States.

grade.line: Two cargo ships sank after being hit by projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz on 14 October, and a tanker struck a mine there on 18 October.

predictions.text: I predict that no new cases of Ebola will be reported in Kenya by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026, and 293 tests will have been conducted.

grade.line: Kenya confirmed four new Ebola cases on 17 October, raising its total to seven.

predictions.text: I predict that there will be another mass stabbing at a school in Poland by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026, possibly in a different city.

grade.line: No further school stabbing in Poland was reported by 19 October; a school stabbing that day was in Romania.

predictions.text: I predict that Ethiopian forces will capture another major town in the Tigray Region, following the recent recapture of Adigrat.

grade.line: No capture of another Tigray town by Ethiopian forces was reported by 19 October; the last report was the retaking of Adigrat on 10 October.

predictions.text: I predict that the search for survivors in the 2026 Budhi Gandaki flood will continue, with at least 10 survivors found in Nepal.

grade.line: The missing were revised to five or six on 11 October, and none were reported found by 19 October.
